boundaries: These are publication observations, not new mathematical theorems or a complete repository-wide exact replay.

No formal availability-mask/MGW correspondence, Rust refinement, sampling calibration or measured learner/sensor benefit is established.
The source, reviews and builds share local tooling and custody; no independent implementation or institutional review is claimed.
PDF native pins are bounded dependencies, not complete native closure. Portable/hosted proof replay and containing-commit hosted checks require separate evidence.
